description: Current standings (league table) of a competition: position, played, won, drawn, lost, goals, points, form and the qualification or relegation zone. Group-stage competitions return every group.

format.description: text (default): compact summary with IDs and links. json: the raw data feed, minified and capped at 60,000 characters

language.description: Language for team, competition and country names, and for the football-mania.com links (en, es, de, fr, it, pt, pt-BR, nl, ar, ru, tr, id, …). Default: en

league_key.description: League key from search (e.g. EnglandPremierLeague), or the competition name

name: get_standings

country.description: Country the competition is filed under, or the confederation for international competitions

groups.description: Group names, when the competition has more than one table

table.description: Every group's rows in order; each row names its group when there is more than one

form.description: Recent results, most recent last, as W/D/L

group.description: Group or stage name, when the competition has more than one table

live.description: true when these points include a match still in play

note.description: Qualification or relegation note, when the feed carries one
